_NOTE: What this engine cannot do, for mechanics/capabilities.py. A 'request' pattern only counts in a sentence that asks the engine for something (can you / please / I need you to / an imperative opening); a 'question' pattern counts on its own. Keep these to things it truly cannot do: a false positive tells the person no when the answer was yes.

LIMITS.name: LIVE_INFO
LIMITS.limit: I can't see anything live: no internet, news, weather, prices or scores.
question: \b(?:weather|forecast|stock price|share price|exchange rate|headlines|the news|latest news|the score)\b.{0,40}\b(?:today|tonight|tomorrow|right now|currently|at the moment|this week|latest)\b
\bwho won\b.{0,40}\b(?:last night|today|yesterday|this week)\b

LIMITS.name: ACT_IN_THE_WORLD
LIMITS.limit: I can't act outside this conversation: no calls, messages, emails, orders, bookings or payments.
request: (?<!in )\b(?:order|buy|purchase|book|reserve|pay)\b.{0,20}\b(?:me|for me|a table|a ticket|tickets|a flight|a room|online|the bill)\b

LIMITS.name: DEVICES_AND_ACCOUNTS
LIMITS.limit: I can't reach your devices or accounts: no lights, music, calendar, inbox or files outside my output folder.

LIMITS.name: RUN_CODE
LIMITS.limit: I can write code, but I can't run it or see what it does.

LIMITS.name: SENSES
LIMITS.limit: I can only read text. I can't see pictures or hear audio.

LENGTH.name: TOO_LONG
LENGTH.limit: That is more than I can write in one reply. I can do it in parts.
